simple.meaning: מְתֹם (mᵉthôm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “wholesomeness ; also (adverb) completely.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Judges, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Judges 20:48. Its contexts include city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְתֹם (H4974).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְתֹם (mᵉthôm) / H4974 is traced through Judges 20:48, Psalms 38:4, Psalms 38:8, Isaiah 1:6 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H4974. methom מְתֹם noun [masculine] soundness ; in phrase ב מְתֹם ׳אֵין Isa 1:6 ; Psa 38:4 ; 38:8 ; מְ֯תֹם מֵעִיר Judg 20:48 from entire city (Manuscripts De Rossi Bu GFM מְתִם , see מַת and compare מת(י)ם עיר Deut 2:34 ; 3:6 ; Job 24:12 ). תֵּמָנִי תֵּמָן, see תֵּימָן below ימן . תִּמְנַת תִּמְנִי, תִּמְנָ֫תָה, תִּמְנָה, see מנה . תִּמְנָע see מָנַע . תֶּ֫מֶס see מסס . תמר (√of following; compare perhaps Arabic be erect, stiff (e.g. of lance), so Buhl 13 , who derives thence תמר palm-tree , and also תִּימָרָה , Late Hebrew תִּמָּרָה column of smoke, Late Hebrew תִּמּוּר rising motion , etc., but these denominative from תָּמָר Levy NHWB Buhl 14 ; compare Arabic date , Ethiopic id. , date-palm , Aramaic תַּמְרָא , date-palm , Late Hebrew תָּמָר date (-palm) )).
